narrative.intro: Northrop Grumman Systems has $2.9B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Northrop Grumman Systems received 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $1.4B, and obligations are up 124.5% year over year. Historical obligations show fiscal-year totals of $1.1B in FY21, $2B in FY22, $2.9B in FY23, $3.5B in FY24, and $1.3B in FY25, followed by the current-year total of $2.9B. Market concentration in FY2026 to date is clear: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing accounts for $2.9B of obligations while Engineering Services accounts for $1.7M. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and current-year totals are partial fiscal-year-to-date amounts. This profile is a snapshot of FY2026 activity and shows where contract dollars are recorded so far this fiscal year.
